summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal transactions and developments in the retail sector, particularly focusing on IPOs and growth strategies.

bullets.text: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised on Adani Power's 770 MW hydroelectric project joint venture in Bhutan.
Kanga & Co facilitated Bandhan TMX's proposed IPO, valued at over ₹280 crore.
Asian Footwears plans a ₹100 crore manufacturing expansion and aims to open 150 stores by FY27.
Myntra reported a net loss of ₹579 crore in FY26, with revenue dropping 13%.
Reliance Industries shareholders needed to purchase shares by October 13 to qualify for Jio Platforms’ ₹2,500 crore shareholder quota.
